ABOUT OUR STUDIO

CLIENTS LOVE US

What Our Clients Are Saying
“

Twelve white cubes float like thoughts in a 6 m void. The light well breathes with the day, concrete warms underfoot, and every sculpture finds its perfect shadow. Artists cry on opening night. This isn’t a showroom—it’s a cathedral of light.

— Freja Nielsen

Nordhavn, Copenhagen

120 founders now fight over the 12 m table at sunrise. The moss wall eats our CO₂, the harbour ferries wave hello, and the Wi-Fi never drops—even when the Opera House lights up. We signed the lease sight-unseen after one render. Best blind date ever.

— Haruto & Zoe Chen

The Rocks, Sydney

We wanted a cabin that disappears into the forest yet hugs us when the wind howls. Now the black pine drinks the snowlight, the stove sings, and the 9-metre window frames auroras like living art. We ski in, kick off boots, and the room is already warm. Hygge isn’t a word here; it’s the air we breathe.

— Frida & Lars Berg

Geilo, Norway

We open at 6 a.m.; the bar flips down like a drawbridge and the laneway becomes ours. Rooftop basil hits the pesto at 8. By 10 the queue snakes around the corner, yet the 3 a.m. curfew is never broken—the bar simply flips up and becomes street art. Zero waste, zero noise, 100 % magic.

— Luca Moretti

Hosier Lane, Melbourne

Guests walk in and forget they’re in a 1.8 m hallway. The brass river turns midnight into champagne hour, velvet swallows jet-lag, and the scent of fig leaf makes every arrival feel like a homecoming. We’re fully booked before the paint dries.

— Camille Dubois

Soho, London

We tore the wall down and the Pacific moved in. Coffee at sunrise, wine at sunset—every hour the room changes color with the sea. Friends walk in and literally gasp. This isn’t a living room; it’s a front-row seat to the universe.

— Sienna Vega

Malibu, CA
